objective: Search for net annual profit >500% and >=20 completed BTC trades per calendar day; do not promise or synthesize the target.
trend_channel_override: No profit target; causal trailing stop plus opposite half-length channel close signal; maximum hold 288 bars.
source: BTCUSDT Binance USD-M 1m trade OHLCV and realized funding; no synthetic candles or cross-venue performance attribution.
discovery: 2022-2023; historical data already reused in prior study
validation: 2024; historical data already reused in prior study
fresh_historical_test: 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-31, fetched but never inspected for strategy selection; a short historical test, NOT live forward and NOT annualizable
selection: For each family rank on minimum 2022/2023 protected annual net return (ties: aggregate net, config id). Freeze one per family before validation. Admission requires both discovery years positive, >=100 combined discovery trades, 2024 positive, discovery and validation PF>=1.1, DD<=10%. Rank admitted by 2024 return then id; otherwise select the best diagnostic by same 2024 rank and label REJECTED. No selection using 2025-2026 or fresh August.
router: Separately predeclared monthly top-1 or CASH among family winners using ONLY previous 180 days of daily returns with 2-day embargo; require positive net return, >=20 closed trades, PF>=1.1, DD<=10%; fresh replay of chosen signals on one account with shared exposure/risk. No sum of independently margined accounts.
execution: Signals at fully closed bars; next minute open taker. Conservative stop-first when intrabar order unknown; adverse gap/slippage; round BTC qty down to 0.001, min notional 100; <=0.1% of previous minute base volume. Single position, no averaging or martingale. Trailing updated only after bar close and applies next minute. Funding charged only when previously positioned; retain exact published rate and disclose minute price approximation.

costs.funding: realized Binance schedule, required complete; minute-open price approximation

risk_sensitivity: Only frozen selected strategy, risk 0.1%, 0.25%, 0.5%; exposure capped 2x and same loss circuit breakers. No leverage escalation to manufacture CAGR.
reporting: Always report full calendar-year return, continuous reused evaluation, fresh August actual return without annualization, trade frequency, marked and adverse-bar DD, fees, funding and ledger reconciliation. All candidates and rejected outcomes retained.
target_gate: No target pass unless a complete >=365-day non-selection period exceeds +500% net, >=20 trades/day, DD<=10%, stress and venue-specific execution tests pass. Fresh month cannot establish annual target; live_ready remains false without forward and execution evidence.
hyperliquid: Research venue only if authentic matching trade/funding/execution history acquired; do not substitute Binance returns with Hyperliquid fees. No unsupported Hyperliquid backtest claim.
